Noah: Heads-up: Aurora Legal wants a short POC for 'aurora-policy-13b' next month. Requirements: INT4 quant variant, SAML SSO, BYOK KMS, and p95 latency < 300ms for 100-token queries. Can SE/Infra confirm compatibility and any blockers?
Maya: Quick checks: INT4 conversion often successful but depends on activation precision and custom fused ops. Need model.tar + config.json + tokenizer.json. Ask for a ~50-sample corpus to validate tokenization.
Ellen: Security: BYOK + SAML supported for Hosted Dedicated; for Private we can mount their KMS but need key policy review. They also want audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. That affects retention and network setup.
Sam: Infra: to meet p95<300ms at bursts of ~25 qps recommend Dedicated pool: 2x A100-80GB baseline, autoscale to 3 for sustained bursts. INT4 improves perf but increases conversion validation time. Also suggest separate pool for embedding requests.
Vik: Commercial: I'll draft two options: Quick Hosted Dedicated trial (30d) and Private deployment. Estimate for Dedicated baseline + BYOK ~$32k/mo committed; Private includes setup fee. Precise quote after perf numbers/token volumes.
Noah: Action items: 1) Ask customer for model artifacts & tokenizer, 2) SE runs conversion & perf sweep, 3) Security provides SAML/KMS integration notes, 4) Quote.
Maya: Tokenizer checklist sent: tokenizer.json, 100 examples, one long doc for truncation. If many OOVs we recommend remapping or a tokenizer patch.
Ellen: I'll prepare SAML SP metadata template and KMS key policy checklist. Also need data residency (US/EU) to choose region.
Sam: Perf command I'll run:
```
python perf.py --model aurora-policy-13b-int4 --ctx 128 --batch 1 --steps 150
```
Expect initial results in 48h after assets.
